reviews.title: Getting worse by the update
reviews.text:
Edit: Oct-2026
Wyze has become a shell of itself. Events either don’t record at all, or they pick up the event half way through that you have no idea what triggered it. For example, we have a motion sensing light over our driveway. Consistently, Wyze picks up the recording 10+ seconds after the event trigger. The recording shows the light already on, and whatever or whoever crossed the driveway are already out of view. What’s the point, Wyze? 
Also, two new cameras I just bought randomly lose network connection or seemingly die. The next day, they’re inexplicably back online and powered. How far Wyze has fallen. Go with another company. 

I used to love Wyze. Update after update the app gets more buggy and clumsy. 
STOP ASKING FOR MICROPHONE ACCESS. Just stop. I answered once- that should suffice. I shouldn’t be prompted every day multiple times. 

Also, stick to your wheelhouse and stop creating all the new gadgets. It’s becoming hokey at this point. Just stay in your lane and focus on what you’re good at.

Purchased because recent events have made it necessary.  Have been using 24 hours and had to turn vehicle notifications off because I face the street and was getting 1-3 a minute for hours.  But I’m not getting notifications of actual people walking by.  I live upstairs and our downstairs neighbor has a dog who barks at everyone, and that’s when I’ll pick up my phone and see people walking by or sitting on the stairs in the video, but still no notification from this app.  It only let me know about vehicles driving by with Motion Completed.

UPDATE:  because how does this camera pick up the leaves blowing but it didn’t get the person putting something large in front of our stairs last night?  Thankful for the free month trial currently because I might be switching to Ring.

DAY 3: recorded video of someone screaming out front, heard the audio on the app.  The recording was silent.  Very upset because I need proof of these things!  Plus they keep spamming marketing notifications and emails after I turned them off.   Spend a little more on something else because not only do I currently feel unsafe, I am also annoyed!

A WEEK LATER: someone who’s been harassing us literally damaged property (again).  The camera picked up NOTHING, it won’t pick up people, but it sure lets me know when a car drives by every five minutes!!  Don’t recommend at all and will be upgrading.

reviews.title: Continuing to go downhill
reviews.text:
I’ve used Wyze products for years - since their very first camera. Their hardware remains fine. For the up-front price their hardware quality is great. Unfortunately selling quality products at a low price is apparently not a sustainable business model, and their attempts to bump profits are making the experience worse and worse. Their software is bloated, slow, ad-filled, and unreliable. The subscription model makes the actual price for a vaguely usable product suddenly no longer cheap or even competitive. Their AI is ludicrously, embarrassingly bad; stop calling my wife “a dog” please. The AI in particular makes using the app an unpleasant, annoying experience, unless you enjoy the puzzle of figuring out what something really is (is an “environmental trigger” a car? A dog? A marching band?). 

As an example of their incompetence, their “explain why this AI identification” form doesn’t work; you can fill it out, but there’s no “submit” option. It just sits there and disappears when you eventually have to close it. 

I’ve canceled my subscription and use the subscription price to buy several HomeKit-integrated cameras that do the same thing as Wyze without inundating me with ads, charging a subscription for basic use, or insulting my wife on a daily basis.

reviews.title: Every update brings worse news!
reviews.text: This used to be the best app and the best camera available! But with every new update, the features get worse. I just did an update, and now I noticed that my live recording only records every five minutes. The first wyzecam I bought recorded continuously to the built-in memory card, and was accessible over the Internet. I could go online after a trigger event, and watch the entire event from the memory card. It was perfect. Then I was offered cam plus. New features, free forever! But then it wasn't free forever. They asked me to pay. Any amount would be fine, they suggested two dollars. I love the service so I said fine I'll pay two dollars. Turns out the two dollars was only for the cameras I currently owned, and only for the services they were currently talking about. Now, just to maintain the service I Once had, I have to pay a monthly fee. Guys, I don't want any of your special services! All I want is what I originally had! I want to know when something moves to trigger the camera, I want to be able to go online and look at the memory card to see what happened. That's it! That's what I bought the cameras for. Stop adding features that I didn't ask for and then charging me for them!

reviews.title: Well, it’s okay.
reviews.text:
Wish you didn’t have to subscribe to everything just to be able to playback video.  There is no support for older cameras although you can download next gen update to your old camera and it will update cameras firmware to next gen. The techs don’t know about it they just tell you your camer is old - buy a new one! I don’t see the need to generate more landfill. If they were a cool company they would share the hack and contribute to a healthier future. That would boost sales and gain huge favor with their markets. Cuz, how cool is it to be able to buy one camera that lasts a long time and doesn’t require the constant purchasing of cameras. In the end I have to have two systems because Wyze wants to nickel and dime you for basic functionality.  Price point was nice, but you can’t even watch video without subscribing to cam plus and that doesn’t work after a few months. You will be wondering what Cam plus is supposed to do for you. And you still won’t be able to playback any video. As long as you are willing to keep paying monthly fees and endure a constant barrage of advertising pushing you to cam plus- then you’re good to go. The newer cameras work pretty well, but they track windy trees any day  over a car in your drive way. The software is not that responsive to your input.  
I use a Lorex system as my real security.
